tasks.title: Should a card added by Siri land on top, like one you add by hand?
tasks.description:
🟡 #36 · Siri cards: on top, like the ones you add by hand?

Coral's rec: Yes for Siri and Shortcuts: you added that card yourself, so it should behave like typing it. Keep "behind the top card" for arrivals in bulk (imports, a synced list), where thirty cards landing on top would bury your one job. The cost: several Siri cards added while the app is closed will sit above the card you left on top. On your yes I change it with tests and make build 42, which also carries the wording fix. Build 41 stays out of the Pilot group meanwhile, because its wording is wrong; say "Pilot 41" if you'd rather not wait.

tasks.title: Deck order default: keep One Job's order? And is there a "don't ask again"?
tasks.description:
🟡 #40 · Deck order with an integration: which choice is the default?

Coral's rec: Default to One Job's order, your lean and mine: the top card is what the app protects, and "Later" has to mean something. Skip a general "don't ask me again" for now. Ask once per integration with the default already selected, and let the user change it later in that integration's settings. A general preference only earns its place when there are several integrations (R3.5). Two smaller questions remain in the write-up (answering from a card; whether this replaces R4.1 and R4.3).
